page.content:
The toy community in Andy's room, led by Woody.

How Andy's toys connects

  • Character: Woody — Woody is the pull-string leader of Andy's toys.
  • Character: Buzz Lightyear — Buzz becomes one of Andy's toys.
  • Work: Toy Story — Andy's toys are the ensemble Toy Story is about.

What is Andy's toys?

Andy's toys are the ensemble of Toy Story: Woody the sheriff, Buzz the space ranger, and the shelf of personalities who hold a room together when the kid is gone.

Key threads lead to Woody, Buzz Lightyear and Toy Story.
